coreMemory.english: v. used to express a weaker possibility or tentative suggestion
coreMemory.structure: might do something /ˈmaɪt ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（可能做某事）；might be able to do something /ˈmaɪt ˈbiː ˈeɪbəl ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（或许能够做某事）；might have done something /ˈmaɪt ˈhæv ˈdʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（可能已经做了某事）；might as well do something /ˈmaɪt ˈæz ˈwɛl ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（不妨做某事）

structures.phrase: might be able to do something

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to might → ✅ can might；❌ to mighting → ✅ to might

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。

fixedPhrases.phrase: might be able to do something
fixedPhrases.example: We might be able to finish the update today.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们或许今天能完成更新。

fixedPhrases.example: The browser might have restored an older local copy.
fixedPhrases.translation: 浏览器可能恢复了一份较旧的本地副本。

fixedPhrases.example: We might as well check every card while we are here.
fixedPhrases.translation: 既然在这里，我们不妨检查每张词卡。

fixedPhrases.phrase: you might want to do something
fixedPhrases.example: You might want to refresh the page after deployment.
fixedPhrases.translation: 部署后你或许应该刷新页面。

fixedPhrases.example: One example might not be enough to teach the difference.
fixedPhrases.translation: 一个例子可能不足以讲清区别。

synonyms.difference: might 是本卡核心搭配 “might do something” 中的中性常用选择；may 含义接近，但语体、宾语范围和固定搭配可能不同，不能机械互换。

antonyms.usage: 在本卡核心义下与 might 构成最直接的语义对比；实际使用前仍要核对词性和句型。
